en.title: Pure-black logo
highlights: New Dock / app icon: pure black background, no glass card or corner frame
Larger MT in Futura Condensed ExtraBold — lime M, white T, amber caret
Site Changelog pages (EN / 中文) for release history
Promoted to Stable — in-app Check for Updates offers 1.1.5

zh.title: 纯黑 Logo
highlights: 全新程序坞 / 应用图标：纯黑底，去掉磨砂卡片与边框
更大的 Futura Condensed ExtraBold MT — 绿 M、白 T、琥珀短横线
官网新增「更新记录」页面（中英文）
已晋升为稳定版 — 应用内「检查更新」可升级到 1.1.5

en.title: Logo polish & channel bump
highlights: Refined Dock / app logo: smaller MT mark, frosted glass card, soft glow
In-app updates follow site version.json Stable channel

zh.title: 图标打磨与通道更新
highlights: 程序坞 / 应用图标：更小的 MT、磨砂玻璃卡片与柔和光晕
应用内检查更新跟随官网稳定通道

en.title: Session restore fixed
highlights: Critical: closing or quitting no longer wiped session.json — unsaved tabs restore on reopen
Clearer Dock logo mark
Faster autosave debounce (~0.12s), lighter focus refresh, sidebar animation, IME-safe buffer sync

zh.title: 会话恢复修复
highlights: 关键：关闭窗口 / 退出不再清空 session.json，未保存标签可恢复
程序坞图标标识更清晰
自动保存防抖约 0.12s、更轻的聚焦刷新、侧边栏动画、输入法安全缓冲同步

en.title: Check for Updates reliability
highlights: Fixed update checks failing under GitHub API rate limits (403 when unauthenticated)
Prefer site version.json, then releases/latest redirect, API last

zh.title: 检查更新可靠性
highlights: 修复未登录时 GitHub API 限流导致「检查更新」失败
优先读取官网 version.json，其次 releases/latest，最后才走 API

en.title: In-app update checks
highlights: Silent check for updates after launch when a newer Stable exists
Manual check: MacText / Help → Check for Updates…
About window: website, GitHub, all releases, and one-click update check

zh.title: 应用内检查更新
highlights: 启动后静默检查；有新稳定版时提示下载
手动检查：MacText / 帮助 → 检查更新…
关于窗口：官网、GitHub、全部版本，并支持一键检查更新

en.title: Monokai themes & Sublime editing
highlights: Ink theme aligned with Sublime Monokai; Black / Paper / Snow recalibrated
Autosave for on-disk files; all tabs backed up to session.json
Sublime-style indent, duplicate/delete/move lines, toggle comment, match brackets

zh.title: Monokai 色系与 Sublime 编辑
highlights: Ink 对齐 Sublime Monokai；Black / Paper / Snow 同步校准
有路径文件自动保存；全部标签写入 session.json 会话备份
Sublime 风格缩进、复制/删除/移动行、切换注释、匹配括号

en.title: IME composition fix
highlights: Important: syntax highlight no longer rewrites text during IME marked composition (Chinese / Japanese / Korean)
Default Chinese UI with English in Settings
Multi-line indent and tab drag-out / merge windows

zh.title: 输入法组字修复
highlights: 重要：语法高亮不再在输入法组字期间改写文本，避免打断中日韩输入
默认中文界面，设置可切换 English
多行缩进；标签拖出成新窗口 / 拖回合并

en.title: Language, indent & tab windows
highlights: UI language: Chinese by default; switch to English in Settings (⌘,)
Multi-line indent with Tab / ⇧Tab / ⌘] / ⌘[
Drag a tab out to a new window, or merge tabs back

zh.title: 界面语言、缩进与标签窗口
highlights: 界面语言默认中文，设置（⌘,）可切换 English
多行缩进：Tab / ⇧Tab / ⌘] / ⌘[
标签拖出成新窗口，或拖回其他窗口合并
